subject: Renewal + EU primary with APAC mirroring — scope and pricing discussion
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@acuityhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + APAC rollout ask (EU custody remains)

Marissa,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our contract with Redwood rolls off in late July and we need to lock terms for next year. Two quick priorities from our side: 

1) Keep EU data custody for primary processing — all PII stays in our EU tenancy.
2) Add an APAC mirror region for lower latency to our APAC customers, but that mirror must be read-only and act only as a performance cache with clear failback to EU for authoritative writes.

We’d like a single renewal that covers the term extension + the capacity uplift for APAC mirroring (estimate: +40% peak token throughput) and to confirm the controls around geo-routing and audit logs. Can Redwood provide a concise term sheet with pricing and a runbook for the handoff/fallback behavior?

I’ve attached a short spreadsheet with our expected monthly token profile and a first pass at the timeline. Would appreciate a 30–45 minute call this week to align.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, AcuityHealth
Samir Patel | AcuityHealth

Attachments: Acuity_Traffic_Estimates_May2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + APAC rollout ask (EU custody remains)

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the traffic sheet.

Quick summary of what we can do today and next steps: 

- EU primary custody: yes — we can keep all authoritative processing and persistent logs in your EU tenancy.
- APAC mirror: we can stand up a geo-mirroring cluster in APAC set to "cache-only" mode for inference responses; writes will always route back to EU.
- Failback & auditability: we’ll expose per-request headers and an audit log stream; we can also provide a daily reconciliation job to validate no authoritative writes happened in APAC.

I attached a draft renewal (Acuity_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf) with the term extension and two optional SKUs: (A) APAC mirror capacity as a percentage uplift and (B) a geo-mirroring support add-on with runbook and extra audit retention. Ben, can you price the two SKUs and flag any lead times for capacity provisioning? Sergio, please add a short runbook link and confirm the retention we can commit to for audit logs.

Samir — can we do a 30 minute call Wed 11 May at 10:00 AM CET / 01:00 AM PDT? If that doesn’t work, propose two slots and we’ll pick one.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Renewals & Expansion | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0169

Attachment: Acuity_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, term summary)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + APAC rollout ask (EU custody remains)

Marissa — pricing thoughts below (quick notes, will formalize in the term-sheet):

- Base renewal (12 months): keep prior committed throughput and bump list price by 6% per our renewal cadence.
- APAC mirror SKU: price = 0.55x of equivalent EU capacity (reflects cache-only constraints), applies to the uplifted token peak (Samir’s sheet).
- Geo-mirroring support add-on: flat monthly fee to cover runbook enablement, daily reconciliation jobs and 30-day extended audit retention.

Lead times: APAC cluster provisioning ~3 weeks after signed SOW; can expedite to 1 week with an upfront capacity deposit (30% of first month APAC uplift).

Note: confirm with Legal on wording for "read-only mirror" and the fallthrough routing SLA. I’ll draft pricing lines in the attached spreadsheet (geo-mirroring-term-sheet.xlsx) and share the HubSpot quote id when ready.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: geo-mirroring-term-sheet.xlsx (pricing workbook)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@acuityhealth.eu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + APAC rollout ask (EU custody remains)

Thanks Marissa & Ben — that all sounds promising.

Confirming the Wed call at 10:00 AM CET. Agenda request: 1) pricing breakdown (Ben) 2) runbook and audit retention (Sergio) 3) timeline and SOW milestones (Marissa) — 20 minutes for that, then 10 minutes for Q&A.

Also: could you share the runbook folder ahead of the meeting? We’ll circulate to our legal and security team for a quick pre-check.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
VP, Information Risk & Compliance | AcuityHealth EU
